value: This document outlines the comprehensive resources available for the Chromium project, designed to support various stakeholders. It provides developers with essential design documentation, how-to guides, and contribution pathways, while offering testers guidelines for bug reporting and quality assurance. Users can learn about the project's user experience philosophy, security, and privacy policies. The resources also detail how to get involved, track issues, contact the team, and include a dedicated "Life Of A Chromium Developer" guide for new contributors.
